n: Edison lesson plans and barcode activity book
t: Free Edison lesson plans and a barcode book of seven no-code robot activities.
steps: Download the barcode book or lesson plans from the Edison site.
Print the barcodes at original size on matte paper.
Gather one Edison robot per pair.
Set up a white surface for the activities.
Try the first barcode with the whole class.
Move to the lesson plans for the coding options.
